title: AC1024 variable-owned value-dependency graph output

scope.recordRelation: One source-bound ASSOCVARIABLE suffix child to an owned ASSOCVALUEDEPENDENCY, whose owner field points back to that variable.
scope.outputRoute: The existing rooted associative graph serializer in ASCII and Binary DXF.
scope.physicalBoundary: This receipt does not claim a complete physical-source conversion; the mechanical witness fails strict read admission before the serializer runs.

physicalWitness.independentOwnerCorrelation: LibreDWG projection cross-check in the suffix-profile receipt joins all 17 variables and their value-dependency ownerhandle fields by absolute handle.

sourceEvidence.wireToOutputRelation: The physical code-3 hard-owned handle is retained in m_variableOwnedDependencies. Graph admission requires a unique matching VALUEDEPENDENCY child owned by the variable; the child record carries the DXF owner field. The serializer follows the owned edge, and the generated test reads back the emitted child owner and dependency target.

implementation.behavior: The record writer checks the suffix parse state, bounded zero/one child count, marker, hard-owned role and matching prefix ledger. The graph preflight validates each listed child as a parsed AC1024 ASSOCVALUEDEPENDENCY whose owner is the variable, validates the reciprocal edge at the child, and follows the owned edge during recursive traversal. The source audit also checks that a variable-owned value dependency appears in the variable suffix list.
implementation.failureBehavior: A missing or wrong variable-owned child handle is rejected before destination publication. The generated ASCII/Binary graph test preserves a preexisting destination sentinel and succeeds after the child handle is corrected.

focusedTests.result: PASS 4/4 in 0.91 seconds. Covers generated ASCII/Binary graph output/readback, invalid child rollback and corrected retry, direct variable record writing, and generated physical suffix vectors.

physicalStrictRead.observation: The mechanical read has zero entity/object parse failures and frameCoverageStatus=2 (FinalizedComplete), with 366/366 frames published. Strict admission still fails because opaqueViewCallbacks=228 exceeds opaqueFramesRetainedByAdapter=0. The adapter separately reports 32 standard object frames captured for source correlation; these are not emitted-output retention. `strictDwgReadOutcomeIsComplete` intentionally keeps the source ineligible while opaque callbacks lack an admitted retention/output route.
physicalStrictRead.result: No physical associative DXF output or strict-complete conversion is qualified.

limitations: The generated one-child graph proves this selected serializer route, not direct conversion of the physical mechanical file.
The 228 opaque callback views have not yet been inventoried by source handle/class/record or reconciled to required output roles and an end-to-end output-preservation route.
Any other required associative bodies, extension-dictionary descendants, or unmodeled records remain refused until their source profiles and output paths are qualified.
No native CAD semantic or format support claim is promoted.

planImpact.removedCompletedAction: Validate, traverse and serialize the selected variable-owned AC1024 value-dependency edge in the generated graph path.
planImpact.remainingP4Scope: Census the strict-blocking opaque callbacks, qualify typed serialization or end-to-end replay for source-required records, then bind the complete physical graph to emitted bytes and readback.
